name: Adding To The Bible
overview: Scripture firmly instructs believers not to add to or diminish from God's revealed word, emphasizing the importance of preserving His commandments exactly as given (Deuteronomy 4:2; 12:32). Proverbs warns against altering God's words, highlighting the danger of being reproved and labeled a liar for doing so (Proverbs 30:6). Jesus affirms the enduring authority and completeness of the law, declaring that not even the smallest letter will disappear until all is fulfilled (Matthew 5:18). This teaching underscores the sufficiency and purity of God's word, calling for faithful adherence without human additions or subtractions.
